title: Leo AI PINN ClaimSetEvent (Amendment A-0001, draft 3)
description: One event of the append-only claim-set ledger. eventId is the canonical hash of every other field (including prevEventId), so the events form a hash chain. sampleSetHash (2026-09-16 protocol clarification) is the canonical hash of the sorted sample identities of the claim set -- blind to artifactId, metadata and ordering -- so that the burn rule follows the samples that were looked at, not the bytes they were wrapped in. Chain integrity, SEALED-before-OPENED, one OPENED per claim set ever (by artifact hash and by sample identity), one OPENED per problem revision and the burn rule are enforced by pinn.governance.claim_set_ledger.validate_claim_set_ledger.
